label: Dutch bank retirement annuity
field.name: Name
field.confirmed: Eligible Dutch bank contract with fully deductible contributions
field.room: Verified contribution room allocated to this account per year
help.scope: Enter a qualifying bancair lijfrente. Project returns as value growth. Add the linked payout in Income to schedule ordinary payments.
help.room: Enter the verified annual room allocated to this account after allowing for other policies. The forecast deducts only amounts actually paid within this ceiling.
help.start: Leave blank for accumulation only. Enter the bank’s first-of-month date in the AOW calendar year or within the following five years.
invalid.confirmed: Confirm the eligible bank contract and fully deductible contributions.
invalid.room: Enter the verified annual contribution room, including zero.
invalid.contract: Enter a qualifying first-of-month start and a positive bank payout over at least 20 years.
invalid.locked: Use the linked bank payments to release capital. Keep ordinary withdrawal and closure disabled.
invalid.return: Enter returns as value growth without separate dividends.
invalid.link: Choose one bank annuity with a configured payout contract.
invalid.duplicate: A bank annuity can have only one linked payout.
